evidence.note: Refrigerator door is closed as the user approaches.
Door is being pulled open; the illuminated interior first becomes visible.
Refrigerator door is widely open.
User grasps the still-open refrigerator door to close it.
Door is nearly closed during the swing.
Refrigerator is closed.

events.object_description: Refrigerator main door; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Island dishwasher door is closed.
User pulls the dishwasher handle.
Dishwasher door is lowered open.
Dishwasher remains open.
User raises the dishwasher door toward closed.
Dishwasher is subsequently visible closed.

events.object_description: Dishwasher door in the kitchen island; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Range oven door is closed.
User pulls the oven handle and lowers the door.
Oven door is open.
Oven remains open.
User raises the oven door by its handle.
Oven door is closed.

events.object_description: Range oven door; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Tall pantry door beside the refrigerator is closed as the user reaches for it.
Pantry door is open, exposing shelves.
Pantry remains open.
User pulls the pantry door toward closed.
Pantry door is closed.

events.object_description: Tall pantry cabinet door immediately left of the refrigerator; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Left door leaf of the upper cabinet above the toaster is closed as the user reaches up.
Both leaves of this cabinet are visibly open.
The cabinet remains open.
User is closing the cabinet leaves.
Both leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Left-hinged door leaf of the upper cabinet above the toaster, beside the refrigerator; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Right door leaf of the upper cabinet above the toaster appears closed.
Both cabinet leaves are visibly open after manipulation.
The cabinet remains open.
Closing occurs within the short sampled interval.
Both cabinet leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Right-hinged door leaf of the upper cabinet above the toaster, beside the refrigerator; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Right-side upper cabinet above the knife block is closed.
Its right-hinged door leaf is open, exposing shelves.
Right-hinged leaf remains open.
User holds this door leaf while closing the cabinet.
The cabinet is closed.

events.object_description: Right-hinged door leaf of the upper cabinet above the knife block/right counter; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Left-hinged leaf remains closed while the other leaf is already open.
User manipulates the left-hinged leaf.
Both cabinet leaves are open.
Cabinet closure is underway, with a leaf still projecting outward.
Both leaves are closed.

events.object_description: Left-hinged door leaf of the upper cabinet above the knife block/right counter; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Black Instant Pot lid is seated on the cooker body.
User grasps the lid handle to remove it.
Lid has been removed and placed beside the open pot.
User begins returning the detached lid to the pot.
Lid is being seated on the cooker body.
Instant Pot is closed again.

events.object_description: Black Instant Pot pressure-cooker lid; removed/open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Mint-green rice cooker lid is closed.
User has lifted the hinged lid open.
Rice cooker lid is fully open.
User reaches to lower the open lid.
Rice cooker lid is closed.

events.object_description: Mint-green rice cooker hinged lid; open is treated as on.

evidence.note: Black air-fryer basket is fully inserted.
User grasps the basket handle.
Basket is pulled out from the appliance.
User holds the still-removed basket in front of the appliance.
Basket is pushed back into the appliance.
Air-fryer basket is fully inserted and flush.

events.object_description: Black countertop air-fryer basket/drawer; pulled out is treated as on.

notes: Open, removed, or pulled-out states are represented as on; closed, seated, or inserted states are represented as off. The two leaves of each double-door upper cabinet are reported separately because they are distinct movable parts. Exact individual timing for the first cabinet pair is less certain because both leaves change within the same eight-frame sampling interval.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a residential kitchen in which the user sequentially opens and closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, then manipulates lids or drawers on several countertop appliances.
